page.overview:
Who is Alman IV?

Emperor Alman IV was the fifteenth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 345–362 AG). He was the great-grandson of the eleventh emperor, Estil I, and possibly usurped the throne from his predecessor, Wensic I.

In 346 AG, Alman IV executed Thomas II Atreides and attained Jaddua and a planetary fiefdom. Jaddua and the planetary fiefdom had been granted to the Atreides in 207 AG by Emperor Elrood II (of the House of Saluso Corrino), as a reward for their aid in deposing Estil I and securing Elrood II's accession. Alman IV's rise to emperor marked the return of Estil's line, the House of Alman Corrino, to the throne.

Alman IV ruled until 362 AG, when he was succeeded by his brother Wallach I.
